card.name: Linking words in multiple sclerosis drug comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, with, in, than, the) right after or near the drug name REBIF, OCREVUS or ocrelizumab in multiple sclerosis label text comparing treatment groups with placebo or AVONEX.

modes.label: or after drug name
modes.description: The word 'or' joining REBIF and placebo as comparison groups.
modes.example: patients taking REBIF<< or>> placebo. In RMS trials, 4

modes.label: with/in/than in group comparisons
modes.description: Linking words in 'treated with' or 'than in' phrases comparing treated patients to other arms.
modes.example: developed in some patients treated<< with>> REBIF. Thyroid function tests

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in multiple sclerosis drug trial comparisons, such as REBIF versus placebo or AVONEX.
